subject.title: bug(cost): mid-session writes to bootstrap-injected files trigger cacheWrite spiral on long agentic sessions; bootstrap-cache.ts shipped for #43532 is content-equality, not session-freeze

question: Should OpenClaw provide a platform-level cache-stable bootstrap contract for long Anthropic-cached sessions, and should that contract be session freeze, dynamic file placement, or documentation-only guidance?
rationale: Current code intentionally refreshes bootstrap files for live visibility, while the requested fix changes prompt-cache semantics and likely adds durable config/API surface.

options.title: Add Opt-In Cache-Stable Contract
options.body: Implement an explicit session-freeze or equivalent cache-stable mode that preserves file-tool live reads while keeping the system-prompt bootstrap copy stable across turns.

options.title: Use Dynamic File Classification
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/65438 the primary fix by adding documented bootstrapDynamicFiles/bootstrapFileOrder-style control for volatile files below the cache boundary.

options.title: Document No Platform Change
options.body: Keep live refresh as the intended behavior and update prompt-caching/model-selection docs to warn operators about mid-session bootstrap-file writes on high cacheWrite-price models.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Cache-Stable Contract
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit session-freeze or equivalent cache-stable mode that preserves file-tool live reads while keeping the system-prompt bootstrap copy stable across turns.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the original cache implementation and earlier closure discussion, making him the best available owner for the product/API contract choice.
